requirements.text: The XML Services (XS) shall provide functionality for the registration of XML terms, tags, and structures.
The XS shall provide tools for the design, generation, and consumption of XML schemas and documents.
The system shall provide a registry for producers to submit metadata, XML tag specifications, and related artifacts via web-based forms.
The system shall support both on-line interactive and off-line batch processes for metadata submission.
The registry shall provide discovery capabilities, including viewing tag hierarchies, relationships, data types, and versioning information.
The XS shall provide a mechanism for users to subscribe to notifications regarding changes to information resources or communities of interest.
The system shall support the parsing, validation, and conformance checking of XML documents against registered schemas.
The XS shall provide APIs for internal interface with COE components and external interfaces for non-COE components.
The XS shall interface with existing DBIF, DAC, and COTS RDBMS products (Sybase, Oracle, Informix).
In fixed environments, data management services shall be tunable by on-site personnel to adjust for varying workloads and database sizes.
The system shall allow for user-definable and resettable session time-out values to accommodate degraded communications environments.
The XS shall support the management of various data types, database architectures, and platforms across distributed environments.
The registry shall provide multiple search options, including substring search, to facilitate the discovery of XML tags and metadata.
The system shall support management of usernames, superusers, and access permissions/privileges.
The XS software shall be COE-compliant and portable across COE-compliant platforms.
The system shall enforce naming conventions that do not conflict with established DoD data standards.
